_what: Make pictures and sounds: the style rows (media-generation-style) and the makers they run (media-maker). One runner, do-work/make-pictures-and-sounds.mjs, turns a style into files; records/workshop-media-generation-tool-records.json lists every style here as its own Workshop tool (tool:make-<style>), and the editor's Make panel (src/workspace/media-edit/make-panel.tsx) lists them from this file. A style says what it makes (makes, and the file kind: media_type, extension), what it needs (input_schema: a recording and a moment, a line of text; frames: how many frames of that recording it looks at and how far apart; made_from: other styles' results, made from the same input), how many it makes by default (count), its prompt, and which maker runs it. A maker runs_as an http request that answers with base64 bytes (its key is read from the file the style's credential_mounts places, named by connection, never written here) or a program run in the container. An http maker that Trillion can also pay for names `through_trillion`: the Workshop tool that sends the same request through Trillion's own account at a gateway (`tool`) and that tool's input besides the maker's request body (`input`); a run with no connected account of the person's sends there, through the relay its container is given, and each call is taken from their Trillion credit. A value reference is { value: [path...] } into { prompt, settings, images, inputs, output }; a path part is a key, an index, "*" (first match) or { any_of: [keys] }. Adding a style or a maker is a row here, never code.
